known.note: A XAML OpacityTransition blocks the handoff, so hover, WithAnimation, an enter or exit and keyframes throw, and later updates keep throwing.
A XAML ScaleTransition blocks the handoff, as above.
A XAML RotationTransition blocks the handoff, as above.
A XAML TranslationTransition blocks the handoff, as above.
A declared .Opacity() change overrides a looping keyframe entry on opacity, which the model says holds the channel.
A .Set facade Scale write mixed with modifiers: the setter re-runs and clobbers or is migrated, and throws once the visual is taken.
A facade Translation drag mixed with .Translation(): on main the last writer wins, and resets zero the drag.
